name: diligence
title_zh: EVM 代币链上尽调，先查捆绑盘再谈安不安全
tagline_zh: 拿到一个代币地址，别急着梭哈。先看它有没有捆绑交易、钱包簇、持仓集中度、合约红旗——像审计师一样扫一遍。
tagline_en: Got a token address? Before you ape, scan for bundles, wallet clusters, holder concentration, and contract red.
desc_en: Full on-chain diligence on an EVM token — bundle detection, wallet clusters, holder concentration, contract red flags. Use when the user gives a token address and asks whether it's safe, legit, bundled, or worth investigating.
why_zh: 不是单点查合约，而是把链上行为串成证据链：捆绑检测、钱包聚类、持仓分布、合约风险四层交叉验证。
why_en: Not just a contract checker—it cross-references bundle patterns, wallet clusters, holder spread, and code risks to expose tokens.
limit_zh: 只认 EVM 链（以太坊、BSC、Polygon 等），且需要用户提供代币合约地址。
limit_en: EVM chains only (ETH, BSC, Polygon, etc.), requires a token contract address; no Solana, no price predictions, no investment advice.
title_en: On-chain EVM token diligence: bundles, clusters, red flags
